This page is a placeholder. The server is working and is serving the files in web/dist. Replace this file with your frontend's build output.

Development

Use your framework's own tooling and dev server, no need to be at `localhost:8080/` in dev. Run the Go API (make dev, port 8080) next to it, and call the API with relative URLs such as fetch('/api/v1/items').

Your dev server will run on another port, so tell it to proxy /api to the Go API, to skip configuring urls for different environments. With Vite, in web/vite.config.ts: 

export default defineConfig({
			server: { proxy: { '/api': 'http://localhost:8080' } },
			})

Production

Build your app so its output lands in web/dist (npm run build with Vite's default output directory). The build is embedded in the Go binary, which then serves the app and the API from the same origin.

The JSON API is under /api/v1, for example /api/v1/items.
